context.zh: 个人项目，使用 Codex Agents 协作
context.en: Solo project developed with Codex Agents

summary.zh: 模块化 3D 节奏钓鱼游戏，玩家在持续世界节拍中航行、选择钓点，并通过鱼竿、环境节奏与鱼类性格完成捕获。
summary.en: A modular 3D rhythm-fishing game where players navigate a continuous world beat and combine rods, environmental rhythm, and fish personalities to make a catch.

zh: 让玩家在五分钟内理解并完成首轮钓鱼闭环
用水域节奏和鱼类行为形成区域差异
en: Teach and complete the first fishing loop within five minutes
Create regional differentiation through rhythm and fish behavior

zh: 码头、航行、抛竿、等待、角力、收竿、出售和升级
环境 BPM、节奏卡、鱼类性格和鱼竿增益
en: Dock, navigation, cast, wait, struggle, reel, sell, and upgrade
Environmental BPM, rhythm cards, fish personalities, and rod bonuses

zh: 世界节拍在航行与钓鱼之间持续，抛竿后冻结本次环境快照
表现层只消费领域事件，不反向决定玩法结果
en: The world beat continues between navigation and fishing, while each cast freezes an environment snapshot
Presentation consumes domain events without deciding gameplay outcomes

zh: 使用虚拟时间和固定种子验证节奏与随机性
通过完整 Godot 检查和试玩包验证垂直切片
en: Validated rhythm and randomness with virtual time and fixed seeds
Verified the slice through the full Godot gate and distributable builds

zh: 独立设计并实现模块化 3D 节奏钓鱼游戏，以环境 BPM、鱼类性格与鱼竿效果塑造不同水域的玩法差异。
构建码头到升级的完整闭环，并使用 Codex Agents 推进规格、原型与自动化测试。
en: Designed and built a modular 3D rhythm-fishing game with region-specific play patterns.
Built the complete dock-to-upgrade loop with agent-assisted specifications and validation.

website.zh: 《节奏流域》把钓鱼拆成航行选择与四阶段节奏挑战，并通过环境 BPM、鱼类性格和鱼竿增益让不同水域形成可读的玩法差异。
website.en: Rhythm Watershed combines navigational choice with a four-stage rhythm challenge, using environmental BPM, fish personalities, and rod bonuses to make each region play differently.

full.zh: 这是一个可运行的模块化 3D 节奏钓鱼垂直切片。玩家从码头出发，在湖泊和河流间选择钓点，通过抛竿、等待、角力和收竿完成捕获，再将鱼出售并购买新鱼竿。
full.en: This playable modular 3D rhythm-fishing vertical slice takes players from the dock into lakes and rivers, through casting, waiting, struggle, reeling, selling, and rod upgrades.
